card.name: Individualize dosing instructions
card.fires_on: The pieces of the word "individualize" (individ-, individual-, -ize) in dosage instructions telling the reader to tailor the dose to the patient.

modes.label: Start of the word
modes.description: The first piece of "Individually" or "individualize" at the start of a dosing sentence.
modes.example: Maintenance of Therapy Ind<<ivid>>ually titrate XTAMPZA ER to

modes.label: Middle of the word
modes.description: The word "individual" just before the ending -ized in "must be individualized".
modes.example: must in every case be<< individual>>ized according to patient response and laboratory findings

modes.label: Ending of the word
modes.description: The ending -ize after "Individual" in a dosage instruction.
modes.example: 2.3 Dosage Information Individual<<ize>> and adjust the dosage of APIDRA

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the instruction to individualize the dose to each patient in the dosage section.
